note: A STATUS lattice, not a numeric truth ladder (D-0002-07). Epistemic status is orthogonal to confidence/source_reliability/evidence_strength/truth_degree and must never be collapsed into one score (D-0002-08). CERTIFIED_CONCLUSION means 'formally certified relative to premises', NOT 'more true than a directly observed fact'.

epistemic_types.definition: A raw sensed input with no interpretation.
An interpreted signal attributed to a source.
An asserted statement. LLM/model/external output enters ONLY here (INV-0002-13).
A claim supported by additional independent evidence.
A claim that passed a defined admission process (evidence-bound). Not an external-world truth, not authority.
A conclusion derived from admitted facts by defined inference.
A conclusion formally certified relative to explicit premises (LGGT). NOT execution authority (INV-0002-07), NOT external-world truth (INV-0002-06).

forbidden_transitions_examples: any untrusted source (LLM/MODEL/EXTERNAL_CONTENT/PROVIDER/MCP/A2A) landing above CLAIM by itself
quantity_note: These are distinct mathematical quantities (D-0002-08 / SP0002 §12.2). None equals epistemic_status; none equals another. A high confidence does not change a CLAIM into a FACT.
